title: ONSure Idempotency Record v1
description: 04_ARCHITECTURE_DATA_API_OLICENSE.md SS6: '모든 Write API는 Idempotency-Key를 지원한다.' Persisted by IdempotencyStore.java when a caller supplies an Idempotency-Key header on a workflow request. Scoped to (tenant_id, operation, idempotency_key); request_digest lets a replay with a different request body be detected as a conflict instead of silently returning a response for the wrong request.
